Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (as target_chembl_id), pref_name (as target_name). Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid. molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4. drug_mechanism.action_type = 'BLOCKER'. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
